headlines.text: Looking back to 2023, when Orange Cassidy vs. Swerve Strickland fought tooth and nail for the AEW International Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.03 ? an excellent showing. Battling through injuries built up over 23 straight successful defenses, Cassidy reversed a late rollup attempt from Swerve Strickland to survive and keep the International Championship.
Rewind to 2024, when it was a welcome sight as Marq Quen returned to the ring after just over 2 months away, appearing on Rampage.
On this day in 2023, CHAOS touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.81.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2023, when Dralistico & Vance arrived in AEW as a team in a Tornado Tag match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.12 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
Rewind to 2024, when it was a welcome sight as Mina Shirakawa returned to the ring after 6 weeks away, appearing on Rampage.
2024 brought us this moment: The Butcher returned to the fold after 2 months away, appearing on Rampage.
